title: Noro
summary: An AI-powered iOS productivity assistant that turns unstructured voice input into actionable tasks and schedules activities.
approach: Built with Swift and SwiftUI, using Gemini for task creation and an OpenAI model fallback when Gemini is unavailable.
outcomes: Converts voice input into tasks and schedules activities.

title: Bibi
summary: An AI-powered market research platform in development that turns App Store reviews into consumer insights backed by supporting evidence.
approach: Developing Python and FastAPI research workflows for theme extraction and Q&A across three App Store storefronts. Findings link to source reviews, with validation and tracing to monitor quality.
steps: Organize feedback into pain points, feature requests, and positive signals.
Validate review IDs and findings, and evaluate extraction quality and latency.

title: Onward
summary: An AI-powered job-matching prototype that retrieves relevant opportunities using resume and job embeddings, then reranks results by candidate fit.
approach: Stores job and resume embeddings in Cloudflare Vectorize and uses Cloudflare Workers AI for LLM-based reranking. A Hono backend serves personalized recommendations to a React application.
outcomes: Built a prototype for personalized job recommendations.
